Direct universal reindex invariant negation; signed32/unsigned-bit representability arithmetic. statement: For the observed coefficient-index snapshot old[0,2,0] copied to new[2,3,4] with livebasis3, three operational table updates preserve every original coefficient through matrixlookup. Rewritten basislookup3 disagrees for every coefficient content, and an in-range newindex2 can denote a different coefficient; Lean directly negates the universal wrong-table invariant. Exact signed32/unsigned-bit representability is included. Native trace authenticity and Cpointer/fullF4Run refinement are not claimed.
